item.title: ELA Release Standalone Single & Video for Abba’s “SOS”
item.description: German melodic power metal band ELA return with a powerful standalone release: a reimagined cover of ABBA’s timeless classic “SOS”, accompanied by an official music video. Originally released in 1975, “SOS” is one of ABBA’s most iconic and emotionally charged songs – a milestone in pop history which blends vulnerability, melodic brilliance and universal appeal. item.title: BEYOND THE BLACK Forced to Postpone Remaining Tour Dates Due to Health Emergencies
item.description: Due to two unforeseen medical emergencies within the band, Beyond The Black are unfortunately forced to reschedule the final four shows of their current Rising High Tour in Europe. Guitarist Chris Hermsdörfer will undergo emergency surgery for a detached retina, while drummer Kai Tschierschky is still battling a severe influenza. In both cases, the health of their bandmates is the top priority. As […]
